description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of exchange with effect from 20.02.2023 to 26.02.2023
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory matter under customs law, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). The content involves regulatory compliance requirements for customs payments rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
